That’s a relief.Nhẹ cả người
It’s on me. / It’s my treat.Để tớ trả
Cheers!Cạn ly! / Cảm ơn! (BrE)

MẸO HỌC: HỌC THEO “CẶP HỎI – ĐÁP”

Thay vì học câu rời rạc, hãy học theo cặp (Hỏi → Đáp), rồi tập đóng vai cùng bạn (hoặc tự nói 2 vai). Chỉ cần 5 cặp mỗi ngày, trong 1 tháng bạn nắm hơn 150 phản xạ giao tiếp.

BT. Chọn đáp án đúng cho mỗi cuộc hội thoại ngắn dưới đây

Câu 1. “What an attractive hair style you have got, Mary!” - “______.”

A. Thank you very much. I am afraid.
B. You are telling a lie.
C. Thank you for your compliment.
D. I don’t like your sayings.

Câu 2. “You look great in this new dress.” - “______”.

A. With pleasure.
B. Not at all.
C. I am glad you like it.
D. Do not say anything about it.

Câu 3. “How well you are playing!” - “______”.

A. Say it again. I like to hear your words.
B. I think so. I am proud of myself.
C. Thank you too much.
D. Many thanks. That is a nice compliment.

Câu 4. “Thanks for the nice gift you brought to us!” - “______”.

A. Actually speaking, I myself don’t like it.
B. Welcome! It’s very nice of you.
C. All right. Do you know how much it cost?
D. Not at all. Don’t mention it.

Câu 5. “Would you like a drink?” - “______”.

A. I don’t like coffee.
B. I prefer tea.
C. Coffee, please.
D. I’m very thirsty.

Câu 6. “How much was your new shirt?” -“______”.

A. It’s a red shirt.
B. It’s very cheap.
C. It was in a shop.
D. I love it much.

Câu 7. How long does it take to get to Dave’s place from your flat?” - “______”.

A. It’s a long way.
B. About one kilometer.
C. Thirty five minutes.
D. No. It’s faster if you fly there.

Câu 8. “Do you find it very interesting to travel alone?” - “______”.

A. Yes, you’re welcome.
B. Never mind.
C. No, not at all.
D. It’s exciting.

Câu 9. “Would you like to have dinner with me?” – “______”.

A. Yes, it is.
B. Yes, so do I.
C. I’m very happy.
D. Yes, I’d love to.

Câu 10. Can you tell me the way to the nearest post office? – “______”.

A. Turn left and then right.
B. It’s about two kilometers.
C. It opens at nine o’clock.
D. You can walk or go there by taxi.

title: KĨ NĂNG ĐỌC HIỂU
html:
Chuyên đề 28 · Đột phá kiến thức
KĨ NĂNG ĐỌC HIỂU
Học đúng trọng tâm · Nhớ lâu · Làm bài nhanh · READING COMPREHENSION
CHỐT ĐỘT PHÁ — 4 ĐIỀU PHẢI NHỚ
Công thức vàng
Đọc câu hỏi trước, gạch từ khóa, rồi đọc bài tìm vị trí chứa từ khóa. Đáp án thường là cách diễn đạt khác (paraphrase) của câu trong bài.
Dấu hiệu nhận biết
Câu hỏi ý chính: tìm ở câu mở đầu và câu kết của đoạn. Câu hỏi từ vựng: thay đáp án vào ngữ cảnh và xét cả câu.
Bẫy hay gặp
Đáp án đúng từ nhưng sai ý. Câu NOT, EXCEPT, FALSE hỏi điều không có hoặc sai trong bài. Chọn theo thông tin trong bài, không theo hiểu biết cá nhân.
Mẹo làm nhanh
Chia thời gian: 1 phút đọc câu hỏi, 3-4 phút đọc bài, 1 phút kiểm tra lại các câu NOT/EXCEPT.

MỤC TIÊU

Đọc hiểu nhanh, chính xác: nắm 8 dạng câu hỏi, kỹ thuật đọc câu hỏi trước, nhận diện bẫy đáp án và quản lý thời gian (khoảng 8–10 phút/bài).

QUY TRÌNH 5 BƯỚC LÀM BÀI ĐỌC

  • 1. Đọc lướt câu hỏi (15–20 giây) để biết cần tìm gì.
  • 2. Skim đoạn văn: đọc câu đầu và câu cuối mỗi đoạn để nắm chủ đề.
  • 3. Gạch từ khóa trong câu hỏi (tên riêng, số liệu, động từ đặc biệt).
  • 4. Scan bài để tìm từ khóa hoặc paraphrase (từ đồng nghĩa); đọc quanh câu đó.
  • 5. Loại trừ đáp án sai theo mẫu bẫy ở dưới, chọn đáp án đúng.

8 DẠNG CÂU HỎI & CÁCH XỬ LÝ

DạngDấu hiệu câu hỏiCách làm
Main idea / titleWhat is the passage mainly about? · The best title…Đọc câu đầu / cuối đoạn; đáp án đúng bao quát nhất, không quá hẹp, không quá rộng
DetailAccording to the passage… · Which is true…Scan từ khóa → đọc câu chứa nó và câu trước, sau
NOT / EXCEPT / FALSEAll of the following are mentioned EXCEPT…Gạch từng phương án, tìm 3 cái có; còn 1 cái không có là đáp án
Vocabulary in contextThe word “X” is closest in meaning to…Đọc câu trước / sau, thử thay thế; chú ý nghĩa phù hợp ngữ cảnh
ReferenceThe word “it / they / this” refers to…Tìm danh từ phù hợp về số (ít / nhiều) và nghĩa ở câu trước; thay thử vào
InferenceIt can be inferred that… · The author implies…Không có sẵn nguyên văn; chọn điều được suy ra chặt chẽ từ thông tin có trong bài
Author’s purpose / toneThe author’s attitude is… · The purpose of the passage is…Quan sát từ thái độ: admire, criticize, warn, inform, persuade; từ cảm xúc (unfortunately, impressive)
Organization / paragraphParagraph 2 mainly discusses… · What would follow…Đọc topic sentence của đoạn / đoạn cuối để đoán nội dung tiếp theo

5 MẪU BẪY ĐÁP ÁN THƯỜNG GẶP

BẫyBiểu hiện
Quá tuyệt đốiCó all, always, never, only, completely, must, none (bài thường dùng some, often, may)
Đúng nhưng không được nhắc tớiNghe đúng đời thường nhưng bài không nói
Chỉ đúng một phầnMột nửa khớp, nửa còn lại sai / lệch
Đảo ngược ýDùng đúng từ khóa nhưng nghĩa ngược (nguyên nhân ↔ kết quả, tăng ↔ giảm)
Lấy chi tiết sai chỗSố liệu / tên riêng đúng nhưng của ý khác

Đáp án đúng thường là paraphrase (diễn đạt khác) của câu trong bài, không sao chép nguyên văn.

NGỮ CẢNH ĐOÁN TỪ MỚI — 5 “MANH MỐI”

Manh mốiTừ nhận diệnVí dụ
Định nghĩais, means, refers to, that is, which isA nomad is a person who moves from place to place.
Đồng nghĩaor, in other words, also called, namelyThe arid or dry land…
Trái nghĩabut, however, unlike, whereas, in contrastUnlike his frugal brother, he spent a lot.
Ví dụsuch as, for example, like, includingCereals such as rice and wheat…
Nguyên nhân – kết quảbecause, so, therefore, as a resultBecause of the drought, crops died.

TỪ VỰNG HỌC THUẬT XUẤT HIỆN LIÊN TỤC TRONG BÀI ĐỌC

NhómTừ / cụm
Nguyên nhân – kết quảresult in, lead to, give rise to, contribute to, stem from, be attributed to, due to, owing to, thereby, consequently, hence
Ý kiến, tranh luậnargue, claim, assert, maintain, advocate, suggest, imply, acknowledge, dispute, challenge, undermine, reinforce
So sánh – đối lậpwhereas, while, in contrast, nevertheless, nonetheless, albeit, on the contrary, by comparison
Số lượng – mức độa wide range of, the majority of, a minority of, a significant number of, substantially, considerably, marginally, approximately, roughly
Chủ đề hay gặpclimate change, renewable energy, urbanization, globalization, artificial intelligence, biodiversity, sustainable development, public health, social media, remote work, education reform
Cụm liên kết văn bảnin terms of, with regard to, according to, as far as … is concerned, in the light of, on the whole, to a certain extent

BÍ QUYẾT TĂNG TỐC ĐỘ ĐỌC TRONG 30 NGÀY

  • Mỗi ngày đọc 1 bài ngắn (200–300 từ) trong BBC Learning English, VOA Learning English, The Guardian, National Geographic.
  • Đọc 3 lần: lần 1 hiểu ý chính; lần 2 gạch từ mới; lần 3 tóm tắt bằng 2 câu.
  • Luyện đọc theo cụm (chunk) thay vì đọc từng từ: “in the early morning / of the old city”.
  • Không dịch từng từ: nếu 1 từ lạ ảnh hưởng không lớn tới ý chính, bỏ qua và đọc tiếp.
  • Cuối tuần: tự đặt 5 câu hỏi cho bài đã đọc, rồi tự trả lời.

CLOZE TEST (ĐIỀN TỪ VÀO ĐOẠN VĂN) — MẸO RIÊNG

  • Đọc cả đoạn trước, đừng điền ngay chỗ trống đầu tiên.
  • Xác định đang hỏi ngữ pháp (giới từ, thì, mạo từ, liên từ, đại từ) hay từ vựng (collocation, cụm cố định).
  • Đọc câu trước và sau chỗ trống để biết quan hệ (đối lập, nguyên nhân, bổ sung).
  • Với liên từ: however / therefore / moreover / although / because → suy ra quan hệ ý.
  • Sau khi điền xong, đọc lại cả đoạn một lần để kiểm tra tính mạch lạc.

BT 1. Đọc đoạn văn dưới đây và chọn đáp án đúng cho mỗi câu hỏi sau

From the start of his career as a writer, Mark Twain was fascinated with inventions. As a result, he chose to spend much of his available income on various types of inventions, generally without much success. In fact, he lost most of the money he invested. By 1887, the 49-year-old author had invested most of his money in one project, the Paige typesetting machine.

Twain expected the Paige machine to be completed in 1889. Unfortunately, the machine was never completely finished, and by the early 1890s, Twain knew he was in a serious financial situation. He worked hard to take care of his problems by producing a number of books in a row. He wrote A Connecticut Yankee in King Arthur’s Court (1892), An American Claimant (1892), Tom Sawyer Abroad (1893), and Pudd’nhead Wilson (1894). However, all of these works did not solve his financial problems, and he was forced to declare bankruptcy.

Câu 1. This passage mainly discusses how an author ______.

A. invested poorly in inventions
B. wrote so many books
C. created his famous works
D. created a successful invention

Câu 2. According to the passage, what interested Mark Twain?

A. giving investment advice
B. work as a typesetter
C. the world of banking
D. new ideas and products

Câu 3. Where was the majority of Twain’s money in 1887?

A. in a bank account
B. invested in various inventions
C. invested in one invention
D. invested in his writings

Câu 4. It can be inferred from the passage that the Paige machine was ______.

A. created by Mark Twain
B. ready in the 1890s
C. close to being completed
D. a great success

Câu 5. Look at the expression "in a row"in paragraph 2. This expression could be best replaced by ______.

A. one after another
B. very quickly
C. on time
D. in a straight line

BT 2. Đọc đoạn văn dưới đây và chọn đáp án đúng cho mỗi câu hỏi sau

Coca Cola is a popular drink for people all over the world. At first, very few people drank Coca Cola, but now it is sold in more than 160 countries. More than 1,6 billion gallons are sold every year. Coca Cola was invented by Dr John Pemberton in Atlanta on 8 May, 1886. However, the name Coca Cola was given by Frank Robinson, one of Dr Pemberton s partners. Later, in 1888, the business was sold to another man, Asa Candler. He opened his first factory to produced this drink in 1895 in Dallas, Texas. Since then, a great quantity of Coca Cola has been produced there.

Since 1982, a special kind of Coca Cola has been made for overweight people - diet Coke. They have used many clever advertisements to increase the amount of Coca Cola sold every year.

Besides Coca Cola, there are many other drinks of the same kind sold al over the world such as Pepsi Cola. Sp - Cola and Dr People. However Coca Cola is the most popular People drink Coca Cola with their meals. when they are thirsty or when they socialise with friends. It is certain that more and more people will drink Coca Cola all over the world in this century.

Câu 1. Coca Cola was first made______.

A. in the USA
B. in England
C. in Australia
D. in Canada

Câu 2. The name Coca Cola was given to the drink by______.

A. Dr Pemberton
B. Asa Candler
C. Frank Robinson
D. Dr Pepper

Câu 3. Every year, people all over the world drink about ______ gallons of Coca Cola.

A. 1,6 million
B. 1,6 billion
C. 16 million
D. 16 trillion

Câu 4. Diet Coke is used for______people.

A. fat
B. sick
C. thin
D. small

Câu 5. Coca Cola is______.

A. more popular than other drinks of the same kind
B. less popular than other drinks of the same kind
C. as popular as Sp Cola
D. as not popular as other drinks of the same kind

BT 3. Đọc đoạn văn dưới đây và chọn đáp án đúng cho mỗi câu hỏi sau

Scientists are trying to make the deserts into good land again. They want to bring water to the deserts, so people can live and grow foods. Theyare learning a lot about the deserts. But more and more of the earth is becoming deserts all the time. Scientists may not change the desert in time.

Why is more and more land becoming deserts? Scientists think that people make deserts. People are doing bad things to the earth.

Some places on the earth don’t have very much rain. But they still don’t become deserts. This is because some green plants are growing there. Small green plants and grass are very important to dry places. Plants don’t let the hot sun make the earth even drier. Plants don’t let the wind blow the soil away. When a little rain falls, the plants hold the water. Without plants, the land can become a desert much more easily.

Câu 1. According to the passage, deserts ______.

A. can all be turned into good land soon
B. never have any plants or animals in them
C. get very little rain
D. are made by people

Câu 2. The underlined word "They"in the passage refers to ______.

A. scientists
B. deserts
C. people
D. foods

Câu 3. Small green plants are very important to dry places because ______.

A. they develop together with grass
B. they let the sun make the earth even drier
C. they don’t help to hold the water
D. they don’t let the wind blow the earth away

Câu 4. Land is becoming deserts little by little because ______.

A. there is not enough rain
B. people don’t do what scientists wish them to do
C. plants can’t grow there
D. scientists know little about the deserts

Câu 5. After reading this, we learn that ______.

A. plants can keep dry land from becoming deserts
B. it is good to get rid of the grass in the deserts
C. all places without much rain will become deserts
D. it is better to grow crops on dry land than to grow grass

BT 4. Đọc đoạn văn dưới đây và chọn đáp án đúng cho mỗi câu hỏi sau

Helen Keller was a very bright and beautiful girl. At the age of six months she could already say a few words. But before she was two years old, she was badly ill. She could not see or hear, and soon she could not even talk. Since then Helen had to fight for what she wanted.

When she was six, her parents invited a teacher for her. With the help of the teacher, she began to see and hear the world around her through her hands. She learned to read the books for the blind. The teacher took Helen for long walks, and told her about all the beautiful sights. Helen touched flowers, climbed trees and smelt a storm before it came. She also learned how to swim and ride a horse.

After she grew up, she became a famous writer in America. Her first and most famous book is The Story of My Life. Her story brought new hope to many blind and deaf people. It gave light to those in darkness and encouraged them to live and work.

Câu 1. When could Helen Keller already say a few words?

A. at the age of two
B. at the age of a year and a half
C. at the age of six months
D. when she was six years old

Câu 2. Why couldn’t Helen see or hear later?

A. Helen was badly ill.
B. She had a traffic accident.
C. Helen was very tired.
D. She became very lazy.

Câu 3. How could Helen begin to see and hear the world around her?

A. with the help of her father
B. through her feet
C. with the help of her parents
D. with the help of her teacher

Câu 4. After Helen grew up, she became a famous ______.

A. doctor
B. scientist
C. singer
D. writer

Câu 5. What gave light to those in darkness and encouraged them to live and work?

A. their teacher’s help
B. Helen’s story
C. their parents’ help
D. Helen’s songs

title: CÂU ĐỒNG NGHĨA
html:
Chuyên đề 29 · Đột phá kiến thức
CÂU ĐỒNG NGHĨA
Học đúng trọng tâm · Nhớ lâu · Làm bài nhanh
CHỐT ĐỘT PHÁ — 4 ĐIỀU PHẢI NHỚ
Công thức vàng
Xác định chủ điểm ngữ pháp của câu gốc (bị động, điều kiện, so sánh, gián tiếp, nhượng bộ ...) rồi tìm đáp án có cấu trúc tương đương.
Dấu hiệu nhận biết
Các cặp tương đương hay gặp: although = despite + N; too ... to = so ... that ... not; the last time + QKĐ = haven’t + V3 + for.
Bẫy hay gặp
Đáp án đúng ngữ pháp nhưng sai nghĩa; đáp án đổi sai thì; đáp án thừa hoặc thiếu phủ định.
Mẹo làm nhanh
Loại nhanh đáp án sai thì, sai nghĩa, thừa hoặc thiếu phủ định; đáp án còn lại thường là đáp án đúng.

MỤC TIÊU

Nhận ra ngay chủ điểm ngữ pháp của câu gốc để chọn câu đồng nghĩa chính xác. Dưới đây là “bản đồ” 30 họ cấu trúc hay ra đề nhất.

QUY TRÌNH 4 BƯỚC

  • 1. Xác định chủ điểm (bị động, điều kiện, so sánh, gián tiếp, đảo ngữ, because / although…).
  • 2. Nhớ công thức tương đương (xem bảng dưới).
  • 3. Loại đáp án đổi nghĩa: sai thì, sai chủ ngữ, sai logic, thêm / bớt ý.
  • 4. Đọc lại đáp án còn lại; chọn câu đúng ngữ pháp và đủ ý.

BẢN ĐỒ 30 HỌ CẤU TRÚC TƯƠNG ĐƯƠNG

#Câu gốcTương đương
1Chủ độngBị động (People use computers = Computers are used by people)
2Trực tiếpGián tiếp (lùi thì, đổi đại từ, trạng từ)
3If + S + V(s), …Unless + S + V(phủ định) · Provided / As long as … · Otherwise
4If I had known …Had I known … · Without / But for + N
5If I were you, I would …I advise you to … · You should … · Why don’t you … ?
6Superlative: the most … inNo other + N + as / so … as · No other + N + is more … than
7A is taller than BB is not as / so tall as A
8Although / Though + S + VDespite / In spite of + N / V-ing / the fact that
9Because + S + VBecause of / Due to + N / V-ing
10So … thatToo … to · Not … enough to · Such … that
11S + started V-ing … agoS + has V3 + for + khoảng thời gian
12The last time I … was …I haven’t … since / for …
13This is the first time + HTHTI have never … before
14I regret not studyingI wish I had studied
15It’s a pity (that) S + VS wish(es) + S + V-ed / had V3
16S + used to + VS no longer + V · S doesn’t + V + any more
17S + prefer A to BS + would rather + V + than + V
18S + be + able to + VS + can / could + V · S manage to V · S succeed in V-ing
19S + be + good at + V-ingS + be + a good + người làm V
20It takes + O + time + to VS + spend + time + V-ing
21S + find it difficult to VS + have difficulty (in) V-ing
22S + advise sb to VS + suggest that sb (should) V · It’s advisable that…
23S + be + too + adj + to VS + be + so + adj + that + S + can’t + V
24It is said that S + VS + is said to V
25S + began + V-ing / to VS + started + V-ing / to V
26Both A and BNot only A but also B · A as well as B
27S + be + not + as + adj + asS + be + less + adj + than
28No sooner had S V3 than S V-edHardly had S V3 when S V-ed · As soon as S V-ed, S V-ed
29What a beautiful day!How beautiful the day is!
30Not until … did S …It was not until … that S …

ĐỘNG TỪ KHUYẾT THIẾU Ở QUÁ KHỨ — ĐÁP ÁN BẪY SỐ 1

Cấu trúcNghĩaVí dụ
must have V3chắc chắn đã (suy luận)He must have left. = Chắc là anh ta đã đi.
can’t / couldn’t have V3chắc chắn không phải (đã)She can’t have said that.
may / might have V3có thể đãHe might have missed the bus.
should / ought to have V3lẽ ra nên (nhưng đã không)You should have called me.
shouldn’t have V3lẽ ra không nên (nhưng đã làm)I shouldn’t have said that.
could have V3đã có thể (nhưng không xảy ra)I could have won.
needn’t have V3đã làm điều không cầnYou needn’t have come.
didn’t need to Vkhông cần làm (và có thể đã không làm)I didn’t need to go.
mustn’t Vcấm (không được)You mustn’t smoke here.
don’t have to Vkhông cần phảiYou don’t have to come.

CÁC CÁCH LOẠI ĐÁP ÁN NHANH

  • Sai thì: câu gốc quá khứ nhưng đáp án dùng hiện tại (trừ trường hợp hợp lý như gián tiếp).
  • Sai chủ ngữ: đáp án đổi người làm hành động (Tom helped Mary ≠ Mary helped Tom).
  • Thêm nghĩa mới: có thêm “although”, “because”, “only”… mà câu gốc không có.
  • Đổi tình trạng: can ↔ must, may ↔ will, unless ↔ if (không phủ định).
  • Không cùng hàm ý: câu gốc “Hardly anyone came” ≠ “Everyone came”.

Chọn đáp án diễn tả nghĩa gần giống với các câu đã cho

Câu 1. No other metal is as expensive as gold.

A. No other metal except gold is expensive.
B. Gold is expensive, and other metals are, too.
C. Isn’t gold the most expensive of all metals?
D. Gold is the most expensive of all metals.

Câu 2. People use computers for various purposes.

A. Computers are being used by people for various purposes.
B. Computers have been used by people for various purposes.
C. Computers are used by people for various purposes.
D. Computers will be used by people for various purposes..

Câu 3. Sally decided not to do her homework and went to a night club.

A. Sally went to a night club because she didn't have any homework.
B. Sally went to a night club instead of doing her homework.
C. Sally was too lazy to do ber homework.
D. Sally went to a night club after doing her homework.

Câu 4. He lost his job three months ago.

A. It has been three months since he has lost his job.
B. It is three months since he lost his job.
C. They are three months since he lost his job.
D. It is three months ago since he lost his job.

Câu 5. You must never take your helmet off while you are riding a motorcycle.

A. Helmets must be worn at all times when riding a motorcycle.
B. You must never wear your helmet while you are riding a motorcycle.
C. Helmets should be taken off at all times when riding a motorcycle.
D. You must never take off your helmet .

Câu 6. They wanted to apologize for their behavior; that's why they paid for dinner.

A. They felt sorry for paying for dinner.
B. They apologize for paying for dinner.
C. They behaved badly by paying for dinner.
D. They paid for dinner in order to apologize for their behavior.

Câu 7. Jerry said, "I'm studying English a lot at the moment."

A. Jerry said I am studying English a lot at the moment.
B. Jerry said he is studying English a lot at the moment.
C. Jerry said I was studying English a lot at the moment.
D. Jerry said he was studying English a lot at the moment.

Câu 8. When I was a child, we would go to the local park every Saturday afternoon.

A. When I was a child, we used to go to the local park every Saturday afternoon.
B. When I was a child, I never went to the local park every Saturday afternoon.
C. We are used to going to the local park every Saturday afternoon.
D. We have been used to the local park every Saturday afternoon since I was a child.

Câu 9. He found it extremely difficult to learn this subject.

A. The subject was so easy that he could learn it well.
B. It was extremely difficult for him to learn this subject.
C. He had difficulty finding the subject.
D. He did not find it difficult to learn this subject.

Câu 10. Although she took a taxi, Susan arrived late for the party.

A. Susan arrived late for the party because she didn't take a taxi.
B. Susan arrived late for the party because of the taxi.
C. In spite of taking a taxi, Susan arrived late for the party.
D. Although she took a taxi, Susan can't come to the party in time.

title: VIẾT LẠI CÂU VỚI TỪ CHO SẴN
html:
Chuyên đề 30 · Đột phá kiến thức
VIẾT LẠI CÂU VỚI TỪ CHO SẴN
Học đúng trọng tâm · Nhớ lâu · Làm bài nhanh
CHỐT ĐỘT PHÁ — 4 ĐIỀU PHẢI NHỚ
Công thức vàng
Quy trình: nhận diện chủ điểm → dùng đúng từ cho sẵn → giữ nguyên nghĩa → kiểm tra thì, ngôi, hòa hợp và dấu câu.
Dấu hiệu nhận biết
Từ gợi ý thường báo hiệu cấu trúc: despite, unless, wish, so ... that, too ... to, suggest, it takes ...
Bẫy hay gặp
Không đổi dạng từ cho sẵn, không thêm hoặc bớt ý, không quên chia thì và mạo từ khi ghép các từ rời.
Mẹo làm nhanh
Viết thành câu hoàn chỉnh trước, rồi đọc lại đối chiếu với câu gốc để chắc chắn nghĩa không đổi.

MỤC TIÊU

Viết lại câu có từ gợi ý (key word) hoặc từ bắt đầu. Dưới đây là bảng “từ gợi ý → cấu trúc cần nghĩ ngay”, giúp bạn phản xạ trong 5 giây.

QUY TRÌNH 5 BƯỚC

  • 1. Đọc câu gốc, xác định chủ điểm ngữ pháp qua từ khóa.
  • 2. Nhớ cấu trúc chuyển đổi; nhìn từ cho sẵn để chọn cấu trúc đúng.
  • 3. Viết nháp: giữ nguyên từ cho sẵn, không đổi dạng.
  • 4. Kiểm tra thì, chủ ngữ, giới từ, số từ (đúng số từ đề yêu cầu nếu có).
  • 5. Đọc lại: nghĩa phải giống hệt câu gốc, không thêm / bớt ý.

TỪ GỢI Ý → CẤU TRÚC NÊN NGHĨ NGAY

Từ gợi ýCấu trúc / ý tưởngVí dụ
unlessIf … notIf you don’t hurry → Unless you hurry
otherwise / or elseNếu không thìHurry up, otherwise you’ll be late.
provided / as long asChỉ khiYou can go provided you finish.
regretI regret + V-ing / I wish I had + V3I regret not studying → I wish I had studied.
prefer / ratherwould rather + V (than V)I prefer tea → I’d rather have tea.
advise / should / ought to / had betterLời khuyênIf I were you, I’d go → I advise you to go.
allow / permit / letbe allowed to VThey let him go → He was allowed to go.
forced / obliged / have to / mustBắt buộcShe had to leave.
mindWould you mind + V-ing? · Do you mind if…?Would you mind opening the window?
sorry / apologiseapologise (to sb) for V-ingHe apologised for being late.
blame / accuse / deny / admitV + O + of / for + V-ing · deny / admit + V-ingShe accused him of stealing.
difficulty / find it difficulthave difficulty (in) V-ing · find it difficult to VI have difficulty (in) understanding him.
worthIt’s worth + V-ing / S + be worth + V-ingThe film is worth seeing.
no use / no good / no pointIt’s no use / no good + V-ing · There’s no point (in) V-ingIt’s no use crying.
last time / since / forHiện tại hoàn thànhI last saw her in May → I haven’t seen her since May.
first time / never … beforeThis is the first time + HTHTIt’s the first time I have been here.
so … that / too … to / enoughXem chuyên đề 23He is too weak to lift it.
although / despite / in spite ofXem chuyên đề 16Despite being tired, …
because of / due to / owing toBecause of + NBecause of the rain, …
wish / if onlyThì lùi một bậcI’m sorry I can’t swim → I wish I could swim.
suggestsuggest V-ing / that + S + (should) V“Let’s go” → He suggested going.
lack / short of / run out ofnot have enoughHe lacks experience → He doesn’t have enough experience.
It takes … toS + spend + time + V-ingIt took me 2 hours to write → I spent 2 hours writing.
be to blame forbe responsible for / be at fault forHe is to blame for the accident.

CÁC MỞ ĐẦU ĐẢO NGỮ — LÀM ĐƯỢC LÀ ĂN ĐIỂM

Mở đầuCông thứcVí dụ
Not onlyNot only + trợ động từ + S + V, but … also …Not only did he lie, but he also stole.
No soonerNo sooner + had + S + V3 + than + S + V-edNo sooner had I arrived than it rained.
Hardly / ScarcelyHardly + had + S + V3 + when …Hardly had I left when she called.
Not untilNot until … + trợ động từ + S + VNot until he left did I cry.
Only when / only afterOnly when … + trợ động từ + S + VOnly after she left did I realize.
Never / Rarely / Seldom / Little… + trợ động từ + S + VNever have I seen such beauty.
Under no circumstances / On no account… + should / must + S + VOn no account must you open it.
So + adjSo + adj + be + S + that …So tired was he that he fell asleep.
SuchSuch + be + N + that …Such was her anger that she left.
Had / Were / ShouldĐảo ngữ điều kiệnHad I known…, Were I you…, Should you need…
It is / was … that / who (câu chẻ)It is + thành phần nhấn mạnh + that / who + …It was Tom who broke the window.
The more … the more …So sánh képThe more you read, the more you know.
Having V3, S + VRút gọn mệnh đề, cùng chủ ngữHaving finished, he left.

BẪY TRÌNH BÀY KHI VIẾT LẠI CÂU

  • Không đổi dạng từ cho sẵn (nếu cho “despite” thì không viết “in spite of”).
  • Đúng số từ nếu đề giới hạn (ví dụ 3–6 từ); viết đầy đủ thay vì viết tắt để dễ đếm.
  • Giữ chủ ngữ hợp lý: nếu câu bắt đầu bằng Having V3, … thì chủ ngữ hai vế phải cùng người.
  • Dấu câu: viết hoa chữ đầu, chấm câu cuối; nếu đề cho sẵn từ bắt đầu thì giữ nguyên.
  • Chú ý giới từ đi kèm (interested in, depend on, apologise for) – lỗi mất điểm phổ biến nhất.

LỘ TRÌNH 30 NGÀY BỨT PHÁ (TỪ CUỐN SÁCH NÀY)

TuầnMục tiêuChuyên đề
Tuần 1Nền tảng: phát âm, thì, câu phức1, 2, 3, 20
Tuần 2Ngữ pháp trọng tâm: so sánh, gián tiếp, bị động, điều kiện, ước5, 6, 8, 9, 13
Tuần 3Từ & cụm từ: phrasal verbs, giới từ, word form, liên từ, mạo từ, lượng từ4, 12, 14, 21, 23, 24
Tuần 4Chiến thuật làm đề: tìm lỗi, đồng / trái nghĩa, giao tiếp, đọc hiểu, viết lại câu25–30
  • Mỗi ngày: 1 chuyên đề lý thuyết (30 phút) + 1 bài tập bấm giờ (20 phút) + ghi sổ lỗi sai (10 phút).
  • Chủ nhật: ôn lại sổ lỗi sai và làm 1 đề tổng hợp 50 câu.
  • Mỗi tối trước khi ngủ: nói to 5 câu ví dụ bạn thấy hay nhất trong ngày. Não ghi nhớ rất tốt sau khi bạn ôn lại trước khi ngủ.

BT. Viết lại các câu sau bằng những từ cho sẵn dưới đây

Câu 1. My grandpa/ recover/ quickly/ his serious illness/.

A. My grandpa was recovered very quickly from his serious illness.
B. My grandpa has recovered quite quickly from his serious illness.
C. My grandpa will recover quite quickly after his serious illness.
D. My grandpa recovered more quickly over his serious illness.

Câu 2. hilltop/ have/ good/ view/ our village/.

A. The hilltop can make our village views better.
B. From the hilltop, our village can viewed very well.
C. From the hilltop, we can have a better view of our village.
D. From the hilltop, our village can have a better view.

Câu 3. museum/ small/ have/ a lot of/ unique artifacts/.

A. This museum is small, but it has a lot of unique artifacts.
B. This museum is small because it has a lot of unique artifacts.
C. That museum is both small and has a lot of unique artifacts.
D. Being small, this museum has a lot of unique artifacts.

Câu 4. disappointed/ film/ entertaining/ expected/.

A. We were disappointed as the film was more entertaining than we expected.
B. We felt disappointed as the film was less entertaining than we had expected.
C. We felt disappointed just because the film was entertaining as we expected.
D. We were disappointed, so the film was more entertaining than we had expected.

Câu 5. These/ baskets/ make/ thin/ bamboo/ strips/.

A. These baskets were made in thin bamboo strips.
B. These baskets are made with thin bamboo strips.
C. These baskets are made of thin bamboo strips.
D. These baskets were made by thin bamboo strips.

Câu 6. Phong/ walk/ fast/ it/ really/ hard/ keep up with/ him/.

A. Phong walks fast, and it’s really hard to keep up with him.
B. Phong walks fast, so it was really hard for keeping up with him.
C. Phong walks fast, so it was really hard to keep up with him.
D. Phong walks fast, and it’s really hard for keep up with him.

Câu 7. In/ past/ most/ girls/ like/ knit/ sweaters/ themselves/.

A. In the past most girls like to knit sweaters for themselves.
B. In the past most girls liked knitting sweaters for themselves.
C. In the past most girls liked to knitting sweaters for themselves.
D. In the past most girls like knitting sweaters for themselves.

Câu 8. Last weekend/ I/ go/ Van Phuc village/ buy/ nice/ silk scarf/ mother/.

A. Last week I went to Van Phuc village to buy nice silk scarf for my mother.
B. Last week I went to Van Phuc village to buy nice silk scarf to my mother.
C. Last week I went to Van Phuc village and buy a nice silk scarf to my mother.
D. Last week I went to Van Phuc village and bought a nice silk scarf for my mother.

Câu 9. I/ look forward/ make/ own conical hat/ Tay Ho village/ Hue/.

A. I look forward to making my own conical hat in Tay Ho village in Hue.
B. I look forward to make my own conical hat in Tay Ho village in Hue.
C. I look forward making my own conical hat in Tay Ho village in Hue.
D. I am looking forward to make my own conical hat in Tay Ho village in Hue.

Câu 10. He/ say/ he/ be/ artisan/ workshop/ since 2010/.

A. He said he was an artisan of the workshop since 2010.
B. He said was an artisan at the workshop since 2010.
C. He said he had been an artisan of the workshop since 2010.
D. He said he has been an artisan atthe workshop since 2010.
